strategy: Process shadow slot — walk-forward annual re-selection under process_spec_v2.json (k=3 equal blend by Sharpe from the frozen 21-name pool, 2.0x). Bootstrap leg = the already-ledgered 2026 selection (dual_momentum_vol + xs_momentum_top30 + xs_momentum_12_1); first live re-selection 2026-12-31. The measured object is the PROCESS, not any one selection. Historical process MaxDD -57.7% vs the -45% kill bar is disclosed as an accepted risk.
narrative: process_spec_v2.json (research repo, versioned; supersedes wf_process spec v1) + the WS3 walk-forward process evaluation (measured hindsight tax -1.04pp/mo vs champion)

relative_metrics.common_window: The common window starts at max(process forward_test_start, baseline forward_test_start) and rel_* metrics are computed on both slots' tracking over that shared window via core/tracking.py (compute_tracking with the common start date). rel_geo_monthly_diff_pp = process geo%/mo - baseline geo%/mo.
relative_metrics.multiplicity_note: Only the pre-registered process-vs-primary comparison (P12-REL-PRIMARY) decides anything. The process-vs-candidate-X entry is REPORT-ONLY: three-slot cross-gates are a multiplicity machine, so no decision may ever cite it.

power_disclosure.note: The process and primary books share most holdings, so the paired monthly return difference has SE ~= 1.2pp/mo. The P12-REL-PRIMARY threshold (-1.5pp/mo) sits ~0.5pp below the measured walk-forward hindsight tax (-1.04pp/mo) — the leg can reject gross process failure but cannot confirm a small edge; geo legs are disclosed as weak.

criteria.description: Continuous kill: live drawdown from the forward-test equity peak reaches -45% or worse (same bar as the primary — the process runs the same 2.0x leverage for comparability).
Continuous kill-or-recost (mirrors primary K2): realized slippage exceeds 25bp/side over >=3 consecutive rebalances.
Continuous operational pause (mirrors primary K3a): fill rate by notional below 90% on two consecutive rebalances.
Continuous operational pause (mirrors primary K3b): achieved-vs-target gross deviation above 15% on two consecutive rebalances.

12-month SUCCESS requirement: geometric monthly return >= 1.65%/mo. Derived pre-registration: primary success floor 1.8%/mo x process/champion walk-forward ratio — the process is allowed exactly the measured hindsight tax, no more.

12-month SUCCESS requirement (common window, vs primary): process geo monthly - primary geo monthly >= -1.5pp/mo. The measured walk-forward hindsight tax was -1.04pp/mo; a live gap beyond -1.5pp/mo means the automated process is losing materially more than selection hindsight explains.
12-month SUCCESS requirement: max drawdown no worse than -45% over the slot's own forward-test window.

REPORT-ONLY (never a decision input): process geo monthly - candidate-X geo monthly, common window vs the combo_v2_exp slot. Displayed for context on /api/compare and in reports; pre-registered as non-binding because three-slot cross-gates are a multiplicity machine. No threshold exists and none may be added except by dated amendment.

decision_rule.SUCCESS: All three REQUIRED_FOR_SUCCESS legs pass at 12 months (P12-GEO, P12-REL-PRIMARY, P12-DD) -> the automated process is validated as a maintenance mode; year-2 discussion.
decision_rule.FAIL: PK1 fired at any time, or any REQUIRED_FOR_SUCCESS leg fails at 12 months.

P_SWAP.clause: PRE-AUTHORIZED ANNUAL RE-SELECTION. Each Dec-31, research runs wf_select.py against process_spec_v2.json, producing selection_<year>.json (picks, Sharpes, spec sha, data-revision shas, and the selection file's own sha). scripts/build_variant.py --variant process builds the new bundle versioned combo_v2_process.<year>.<sha8>; deploying it into this slot is PRE-AUTHORIZED by this clause and is NOT a protocol amendment — the annual swap IS the measured process. The selection sha256 and bundle version are logged in the slot's state/history at the swap.
P_SWAP.bot_never_self_modifies: The bot only ever runs a committed bundle. Selection happens research-side; the deploy is a human-reviewed commit.
P_SWAP.miss_rule: If the re-selection bundle is not deployed within 10 trading days after Dec-31, the miss is a LOGGED OPERATIONAL FAILURE of the process (recorded in the run report and reviewed at 12 months as an operational finding). It does not by itself kill or fail the slot.
P_SWAP.unported_sleeve_rule: If a selection picks a sleeve not ported to the bot, build_variant.py fails loudly; porting + live-twin parity is a deploy prerequisite.

amendment_rule: Amendments only via dated amendment sections plus a re-issued protocol_process.json with amended=true (permanent — never reset to false) and its new sha256 recorded alongside the original. The pre-authorized annual re-selection swap (P_SWAP) is explicitly NOT an amendment and does not re-bind the protocol sha. Any hash mismatch against the sha256 bound at the slot's forward_test_start permanently flags the test MODIFIED_AFTER_START.
